verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Cursor lets developers manually choose among many models (cursor-docs-7, cursor-supp-byo-api-keys) and even pass an explicit --model flag in CLI/API calls (cursor-supp-cli-github-actions, cursor-supp-cloud-agents-api), but there is no documentation of an automatic 'best model for the task' selection/routing feature. Missing for 10: any first-party or independent evidence of automatic model selection/routing logic, criteria used, or cost-optimization behavior tied to pricing/limits.
